name: managedblockchain
description: Amazon Managed Blockchain is a fully managed service for creating and managing blockchain networks using open-source frameworks.

subcommands.name: create-accessor
subcommands.description: Creates a new accessor for use with Amazon Managed Blockchain service that supports token based access.

subcommands.name: create-member
subcommands.description: Creates a member within a Managed Blockchain network.

subcommands.name: create-network
subcommands.description: Creates a new blockchain network using Amazon Managed Blockchain.

subcommands.name: create-node
subcommands.description: Creates a node on the specified blockchain network.

subcommands.name: create-proposal
subcommands.description: Creates a proposal for a change to the network that other members of the network can vote on, for example, a proposal to add a new member to the network.

subcommands.name: delete-accessor
subcommands.description: Deletes an accessor that your Amazon Web Services account owns.

subcommands.name: delete-member
subcommands.description: Deletes a member.

subcommands.name: delete-node
subcommands.description: Deletes a node that your Amazon Web Services account owns.

subcommands.name: get-accessor
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about an accessor.

subcommands.name: get-member
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about a member.

subcommands.name: get-network
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about a network.

subcommands.name: get-node
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about a node.

subcommands.name: get-proposal
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information about a proposal.

subcommands.name: list-accessors
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the accessors and their properties.

subcommands.name: list-invitations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all invitations for the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-members
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the members in a network and properties of their configurations.

subcommands.name: list-networks
subcommands.description: Returns information about the networks in which the current Amazon Web Services account participates.

subcommands.name: list-nodes
subcommands.description: Returns information about the nodes within a network.

subcommands.name: list-proposal-votes
subcommands.description: Returns the list of votes for a specified proposal, including the value of each vote and the unique identifier of the member that cast the vote.

subcommands.name: list-proposals
subcommands.description: Returns a list of proposals for the network.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: reject-invitation
subcommands.description: Rejects an invitation to join a network.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or overwrites the specified tags for the specified Amazon Managed Blockchain resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the Amazon Managed Blockchain resource.

subcommands.name: update-member
subcommands.description: Updates a member configuration with new parameters.

subcommands.name: update-node
subcommands.description: Updates a node configuration with new parameters.

subcommands.name: vote-on-proposal
subcommands.description: Casts a vote for a specified ProposalId on behalf of a member.
